input.relationship: src/weights.ts#weightDetails value-reference src/weights.ts#byteUnit (forward); src/weights.ts#byteUnit value-reference src/lru.ts#admittedAllocation (backward)

evidence.reason: After edit returns { bytes: allocated * byteUnit }, so the .bytes property is now a scaled value rather than the raw allocated count; callers relying on the old semantics may break.
entryWeight returns weightDetails(...).bytes, so its numeric result now depends on byteUnit scaling introduced by the left edit.

allocationWeight is an alias of entryWeight; the right edit calls it with (bytes, 0.1, 'image') and divides by weights.byteUnit, assuming byteUnit is exported and that allocationWeight returns a byte count.
Right edit divides weights.allocationWeight(...) by weights.byteUnit; if byteUnit is not exported or allocationWeight already returns a scaled value, the result is wrong.
admittedBytes returns admittedAllocation(bytes), propagating any scaling error to callers.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动在 byteUnit 的缩放语义上存在耦合，但缺少测试和注释来确认合并后 allocationWeight 与 byteUnit 的契约是否一致，因此只能给出警告。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/weights.ts 的 weightDetails 明确 byteUnit 的缩放职责（例如返回原始 allocated 或统一在 entryWeight 中缩放），并确保 src/lru.ts 的 admittedAllocation 不再重复除以 weights.byteUnit。
